summary: Helus Pharma Inc. (formerly Cybin Inc.), a Toronto-based clinical-stage biopharma listed on Nasdaq and Cboe Canada, filed a Form 6-K attaching a Canadian Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report and news release. The co-founders, Eric So (President and Executive Chairman, formerly Interim CEO) and Paul Glavine (Chief Growth Officer, formerly COO/CEO), stepped down from executive and consulting roles effective October 26, 2026, retaining board seats. The board appointed Mark Lawson independent Chair and named So Chairman Emeritus. No terms, advisor, or premium disclosed. Watch for succession detail and strategic continuity risk around the serotonergic agonist pipeline.
